_what: FX-INIT-R1 DRAFT initialisation payload for KM_FX_RATE_BOOK. NOT WRITTEN ANYWHERE. Awaiting Owner approval.
_not_production: A proposal under docs/planning/. No Script Property was written, no save was called, nothing was repriced. The Editor tool ships with TEMP_FX_RATES empty and TEMP_FX_CONFIRM empty; this file does not change that.

_source.name: European Central Bank - euro foreign exchange reference rates (eurofxref-daily)
_source.direction_as_published: 1 EUR = <rate> <currency>. EUR is the base of every published figure.

_derivation.direction_stored: 1 USD = <rate> <quote_currency>  (base_currency USD, as 75_ resolves it; 75_ never inverts a stored rate)
_derivation.rounding: exact decimal division of the published strings, rounded half-up to 6 decimal places
_derivation.every_row_is_derived: The ECB publishes no USD-based figure, so all five rows are cross rates through EUR, computed once from the two legs recorded here.

_cross_check_only.name: US Federal Reserve H.10, release of 2026-10-19 (latest data day 2026-10-16)
_cross_check_only.use: Plausibility check of the method only, on the latest day BOTH publish (2026-10-16). It is NOT a source of any rate below: its newest day is older than the ECB's.
